name: presentr-practice
description: Prepare a spoken mock interview for a specific job and get a link to practise it on Presentr Practice.

interface.longDescription:
Presentr Practice prepares a mock interview for the job you're applying for. Tell ChatGPT the role, and the company or the job posting if you have them, and Presentr Practice builds an interview for that job: what it covers and the kind of questions to expect. You get a link to start it.

The interview runs on Presentr Practice in your browser. An AI interviewer asks the questions out loud and follows up when an answer is vague, and you answer by voice or by typing. Afterwards you get a scored review: an overall score, a score for each skill, a summary and coaching notes.

ChatGPT sends the job title, and the company and posting if you gave them. We don't receive your chat history. The full posting isn't stored, only a short summary of its duties and requirements. The link works for 7 days in the first browser that opens it. No sign-in inside ChatGPT: you create an account on Presentr Practice when you start.
defaultPrompt: Set up a practice interview for a dental assistant job with Presentr Practice.
Create a practice interview for a project manager role at Acme with Presentr Practice.
Make me a practice interview for this job posting with Presentr Practice.

positive.prompt: Set up a practice interview for a dental assistant job with Presentr Practice.
positive.expected_behavior: create_practice_interview is called once with job_title "Dental Assistant" and no company or posting. The result has a non-empty title, 1–5 focus areas, 1–5 sample questions and an https://practice.presentr.me/start/… link that expires in 7 days; the reply gives the user the link and says the interview runs on Presentr Practice (by voice or by typing). Opening the link shows the prepared interview with a "Start my free interview" button.

The result has a non-empty title, 1–5 focus areas, 1–5 sample questions and an https://practice.presentr.me/start/… link that expires in 7 days; the reply gives the user the link and says the interview runs on Presentr Practice (by voice or by typing). Opening the link shows the prepared interview with a "Start my free interview" button.

Opening the link shows the prepared interview with a "Start my free interview" button.
